strategic_recommendations: Rewrite every hook to promise a concrete payoff within the first 2 seconds; test with A/B thumbnails that show the payoff visual.
Cap video length at 45 seconds and use exactly 3 cuts: hook, quick visual demo, punchline – this matches the highest‑engagement Shorts format.
Publish at peak US evening hours (7‑9 PM EST) on Tuesdays and Thursdays, when Shorts view velocity spikes for science content.
